name: MZ 10451 (Hubble)
blurb: MZ 10451, a nearby poor galaxy cluster whose brightest galaxy is still forming, seen by Hubble.
label: mz10451-hubble
story: At the heart of this small cluster two galaxies are merging, joined by a bright bridge of stars, as the cluster's brightest galaxy takes shape. Stars stripped from them may be the start of the faint light that fills the space between cluster galaxies.

claims.text: MZ 10451 is a nearby poor X-ray cluster in which the brightest cluster galaxy is forming
Two early-type galaxies at the core are merging, connected by a bright stellar bridge
Tidally stripped stars likely represent an emerging intracluster light component
Hubble imaged the core of MZ 10451, where the BCG is forming
